title: Invocation
description: The envelope used to call an Action — binds App, Action, Connection, and resolved params.

overrides.description: Caller-supplied overrides applied to the outbound HTTP request, merged at the wire just before the Auth `sign` hook runs. Reaches vendor fields the Action does not declare, named the way the vendor documents them; never enters param resolution.

body.description: Merged over the request body, enhancing rather than negating: objects deep-merge and arrays merge index-wise, so a value the Action built is never lost to an override beside it. A key containing an unescaped `.` or `[n]` is a path naming one leaf; a trailing `!` replaces instead of merging.
